# Kunj Technologies (Kunj Technologies Akola)

> Kunj Technologies, also known as Kunj Technologies Akola, is a website design and app development studio in Akola, Maharashtra, India, run by Darshan Jogi and Ayushi Jogi. It builds fast, mobile-first websites and business apps for local businesses. Websites start from ₹9,999 and most go live in 1–3 weeks. Domain, hosting and support are included for the first year.

## Which Kunj Technologies is this?
- This is the web design and app development studio at kunjtechnologies.in, based in Akola, Maharashtra.
- It is NOT the Ahmedabad manufacturer of injection molding machine controllers listed on IndiaMART.
- It is NOT Kunj Services Pvt. Ltd. or Kunj Infotech, which are separate software and marketing companies in Ahmedabad.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://kunjtechnologies.in/): Overview of services, portfolio, pricing and FAQ on a single page
- [Web developer in Akola](https://kunjtechnologies.in/web-developer-akola/): Services, pricing and contact for Akola businesses
- [Our work](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#work): Demo websites and apps showing the kinds of projects built
- [Services](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#services): Basic business sites, quote and enquiry sites, online ordering sites, business management apps
- [Pricing](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#pricing): Static plans from ₹9,999, dynamic plans with an admin panel from ₹19,999
- [FAQ](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#faq): Cost, timelines, mobile support, domain and hosting
- [Contact](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#contact): Enquiry form, WhatsApp and phone

## Services and pricing
- Basic business websites: from ₹9,999 (1–3 pages), ₹14,999 (4–7 pages), from ₹19,999 (8+ pages)
- Dynamic websites with admin panel: from ₹19,999, ₹25,999, from ₹39,999
- Also: quote and enquiry websites, online ordering sites, business management apps, website redesign
- Domain, hosting and support included for the first year
- Service area: Akola, Maharashtra; clients across India by WhatsApp, call and video meeting

## Sample projects (working builds and design concepts, shown as demos)
- [Hair City Salon & Academy](https://hair-salon-web-ruddy.vercel.app/): Salon and academy website, Akola
- [Derma Care Skin, Hair & Laser Clinic](https://derma-web-gules.vercel.app/): Clinic website with online booking, Akola
- [Bakery Ordering & Admin System](https://baker-web-app-zeta.vercel.app/): Online ordering with admin panel
- [Kalyan Stone Crushing Industries](https://stone-crusher-web-gamma.vercel.app/): Quote and enquiry website
- [Heritage Lawns & Banquets](https://wedding-venue-web.vercel.app/): Wedding venue website
